{{Quote|Order! We shall have order!|Vice Chair Mas Amedda|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
The '''Vice Chair of the Senate''' (sometimes referred to as '''Vice Chairperson''', '''Vice Chairbeing''' or '''Vice Chancellor of the Republic''', usually addressed as '''Lord Speaker''') assisted the [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor of the Republic]] in the running of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Duties==
The Vice Chair's duties included:
*Formally opening and closing sessions of the Senate.
*Formally opening and closing Senate debates and discussions.
*Moderating Senate debates and discussions.
*Calling [[Senator/Legends|senators]] to attend Senate sessions.
*Enforcing the procedural rules of the Senate.
*Disciplining senators who break said procedures.

The Vice Chair apparently frequently (or always) was a member of the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Chancellor]] (despite having their own [[Vice Chair/Legends|Office of the Vice Chair]]) and was responsible for the maintenance of the Senate when the Chancellor could not attend in person. As such, the Vice Chair's role was essentially a hybridization of a Speaker of the Senate and a Vice Chancellorship. The Vice Chair abstained from decisions among the Senate, although expressed their opinion when decisions became tied. The Vice Chair served as long as they could maintain the confidence of the Senate, and could be removed/instated in Senate elections independent of elections for Chancellor. While the Senate was in session, the Vice Chair would wield the [[Speaker's staff/Legends|speaker's staff]], a symbolic wooden staff topped with a figure of the ancient politician [[Sistros/Legends|Sistros]], to demonstrate that he held authority over the Senatorial debates.

==History==
[[File:MasAmeddaTCW-SWE.png|thumb|right|180px|Vice Chair Mas Amedda wielding the Speaker's staff]]
In the waning years of the Republic, Senate factions opposed to the current Chancellor would nominate one of their own for Vice Chair. The Vice Chair would then be able to use his control over procedures to ensure that the Chancellor would be essentially unable to get any work done without the approval of the Vice Chair (and thus, the Chair's faction).

This was the case with [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]], who was elected to the position in [[40 BBY/Legends|40 BBY]] by the [[Rim Faction/Legends|Rim faction]] to control Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]]. Amedda continued in that position under Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] until at least the inauguration of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]; it is unknown if a Vice Chair continued to serve until the Senate's dissolution in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] (although it would seem that the position, along with the office of Senior Aide, was replaced with that of the [[Grand Vizier/Legends|Grand Vizier]] at some point). In the New Republic Senate, the [[Chair of the Senate/Legends|Chair of the Senate]] replaced the Vice Chair.
